newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Mostostal-Krakow sees net doubling in 1996. [CORRECTED 09:31 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Polish Mostostal-Krakow sees net doubling in 1996. [CORRECTED 09:31 GMT]

text.p: Polish construction firm Mostostal Krakow, which seeks a main market listing, sees its net profit rising to 4.2 million zlotys in 1996 and to 5.5 million in 1997 from last year's 2.1 million, the firm said on Thursday.
Mostostal Krakow said in its isssue prospectus it expected its sales to rise to 118 million zlotys this year and to 140 million next year from 96 million in 1995.
It earlier said it expected to raise consolidated profit to 8.4 million zlotys this year and 9.7 million zlotys next year from 5.7 million zlotys in 1995.
Its group sales were expected to to rise to 145 million zlotys in 1996 and to 185 million in 1997 (corrects from 1996), up from 117 million last year.
